title: Image requests take the one-step image path and use connected MCP image tools

categories.prompt: Generate a 16:9 banner for our launch that reads “COWORK OS 2.0”, dark background, neon accents

executableTestNames: routes the launch banner prompt to the simple image path
does not require a verification step for an image task
keeps the verification step when the user asks to verify the image
keeps the verification step for non-image tasks

categories.prompt: An image task whose assistant output mentions a provenance note and a launch; verification and repair steps must not get Computer Use tools unless the user asked for native GUI work.

executableTestNames: does not read native GUI intent from the model's own output
removes computer-use tools from a verification step the model described with an app
removes computer-use tools from a verification repair step
removes computer-use tools from a verification step of a grounded image task
keeps computer-use tools when the user asked to drive a native app

categories.prompt: With a connected MCP image tool (mcp_*_generate_image) and the built-in generate_image, generate an image; also deny or fail the built-in tool once.

executableTestNames: keeps MCP image tools in the image-only tool list
prefers a connected MCP image tool in the step contract
requires the MCP image tool, not write_file, when it is connected
completes the step contract when the required MCP image tool succeeds
falls back to the MCP image tool after the built-in generator fails
falls back after a thrown built-in failure and completes on an immediate MCP image
falls back instead of pausing when the user denies the built-in generator
still stops after a built-in failure when no MCP image tool is available
ends as failed when the MCP fallback also fails

categories.prompt: After an image tool succeeds (built-in or MCP), the final answer shows the image instead of commentary sent with the tool call.

executableTestNames: embeds the built-in generator's image in the final answer
embeds every image an MCP tool saved
makes the created-image answer the final result over earlier commentary

notes: Before: the banner prompt missed the image path (16:9 and 2.0 broke the intent regex), got a 3-step plan with an OCR/exact-ratio verification step that drove Preview through Computer Use (4-6 approval prompts), ignored the connected MCP image tool, and ended partial_success after ~4 minutes with only a download link. After: one-step plan, MCP image tool used first with 0 approvals, ~1 minute, final answer embeds the image; a denied or failed built-in generator falls back to the MCP tool instead of pausing.
